# chart-to-data

> Recover numbers from raster bar and line chart images by pixel analysis: linear axis calibration, series color matching, bar edges, line sampling and dominant colors. Python package `trysac-chart-to-data`, import name `chart_to_data`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
